subject: Request: Temporary token grant while PO & contract are on hold
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@novacare-health.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access + interim support while PO completes

Hi Priya —

Great to meet you yesterday. As discussed, Novacare's pilot is ready to go once the PO and legal signatures clear. I know your procurement team flagged an internal legal review that could push things into next week.

If it helps preserve momentum, we can provide a short, temporary token top-up so your engineers can finish the integration and the care-path tests while the PO is in flight. Typical approach: a 7–10 day token grant tied to the trial environment, no billing until the PO/contract is finalized.

Before I can do that I need a quick internal approval (amount and scope). Can you confirm the expected runway you need (days) and a contact at procurement to follow up with? I want to make sure the grant is scoped correctly.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine@redwood.ai] | +1 415-555-0137

Attachment: pilot-scope-1-pager.pdf (stub)

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@novacare-health.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novacare Procurement <procurement@novacare-health.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access + interim support while PO completes

Thanks Jasmine —

Appreciate the flexibility. We expect procurement/legal to clear the PO by Monday (7/5) but the legal team reserved the right to request changes that could extend until Friday (7/9). Could we get a 7-day bridge starting today? That would let our ML infra team complete the final integration and run 2 full evaluation passes.

Contact at procurement is Mark Jensen (procurement@novacare-health.com).

If there's any paperwork on your side (an addendum or temporary MOU) let me know — otherwise a simple token grant with terms is fine.

—Priya
Product Lead, Novacare Health

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Approval request — 7-day token top-up for Novacare (DEAL-NU-4127)

Ben / Marissa —

Novacare's PO is in flight but legal might need until 7/9. Priya asked for a 7-day bridge starting 7/1 to keep their ML team moving. They want to run the final evaluation passes. Proposal: issue a 7-day token grant scoped to the sandbox (non-production) environment, limit to 10k generation tokens and 500 embedding units. No billing until PO/contract is signed; we can automatically revoke at end date.

Why: preserves momentum for a high-probability mid-market expansion deal (pilot went well in demos). Risk: small token cost if PO never completes; mitigated by sandbox scope and revocation.

Can I get your sign-off and, if approved, can someone generate the promo code and confirm that we can attach a DocuSign acknowledgement?

Thanks,
Jasmine

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 11:15:38 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Approval request — 7-day token top-up for Novacare (DEAL-NU-4127)

Jasmine —

Approve. Please cap at 8,000 generation tokens and 400 embedding units (conservative). Add the sandbox-only flag and auto-revoke 23:59 UTC on 2027-07-08. Also require a one-line email from Priya acknowledging the temporary nature and that billing starts once the PO is signed.

Marissa — tagging you in case legal wants to mirror this with an acknowledgement DocuSign.

Ben
Director, Sales — East

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@novacare-health.com>
Cc: Mark Jensen <procurement@novacare-health.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: temporary sandbox tokens for Novacare (DEAL-NU-4127) — action required

Hi Priya / Mark —

Quick update: internal approval granted per Ben's note. We've issued a promo code scoped to Novacare's sandbox with the following parameters:

- Code: NOVA-TEMP-7742
- Allocation: 8,000 generation tokens + 400 embedding units
- Scope: sandbox environment only (token use flagged to prevent production operations)
- Valid: from 2027-07-01 00:00 UTC through 2027-07-08 23:59 UTC (auto-revoked)

Next steps: please reply to this thread with a one-line acknowledgement ("Novacare accepts temporary sandbox grant; billing will commence after PO/contract execution") and we will attach a short DocuSign acknowledgement for your records.

Attachments: signature-request-docusign.pdf (stub) — Marissa, can you please route the DocuSign and confirm the stub matches the top-up terms?

Thanks —
Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
